label: ODI ZTE DFP-34G-2C2 GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT built into an SFP module (ZTE ZX279125 @ 600 MHz, ZTE Linux 2.6.32, dual-boot) that presents itself to the host router as a 1 Gbit/s SGMII Ethernet interface (no HSGMII); GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on SC/UPC with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over its web UI or telnet.
